lines: Ride for three hours, and Telo Ride stays as light as it started.
Each second writes one speed into a buffer sized for four hours, set aside when the ride begins.
Totals are running sums, and boards hold only the riders on them now. Nothing grows with the ride.
At the finish, the ride goes out with ten thousand eight hundred samples, one a second.
A minute from the end of three hours, from a phone to the full screen.
What the tests prove: one sample a second, and a buffer that holds the longest ride.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
